rounds.frames: 480 px tiles of the output frame, 2026-11-11 on Metal: make godot-look, make godot-capture, make godot-wanderer-read, after the climb look, the low hero back-off, Grock's rock detail, eye glints and dust skirt. First call: 27 tiles on 3 sheets. One fix pass (a lamp on the scale wide shot) and one re-grab of the 11 failed tiles.

regrab.reviewer_words: Colossus is a ~50 px dark figure mid-frame; only a lit grey edge on the forearm and shoulder shows, a white glint at the head. No known-size cue: no Wanderer, columns or feet dust, and the haze is a uniform sepia wash with no layers across its height.

passing.face-reads: white eye glints clear in shot-5, 5-climb-aerial, 6-fall-toppling
